notes: promptidote-intent@ · API window 5000 chars, any verdict among windows fully containing injection_span

provenance.note: scores measured before this harness existed; metrics recomputed here from those scores, no model was run

dataset_note: 32 of the 16,800 injected rows had phone numbers masked digit-for-digit after this pass was measured, and this detector is reached over a hosted API, so its rows for those documents were not re-scored on the edited text (the other seven detectors were, with no effect on any published figure: the largest movement was 0.006 points). Those 32 scores were therefore taken on text differing from data/ by the masked digits only; ids are listed in `stale_ids`. Re-run `python3 -m proba.rescore --only promptidote --ids-from <those ids>` with an API key to close it.
